BREAKING: Total consumer credit surged +$18.1 billion in July, to a record $5.19 trillion.

This follows +$14.6 billion in June and marks the 13th consecutive monthly increase.

Revolving credit, which includes credit cards, jumped +$2.8 billion, to a record $1.36 trillion.
